title: Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim is the key of the holy land
body:
Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim, Bismillahi-r-Rahmanir-Rahim. Meded, ya Sultan-ulAwliya. Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim is the key of the holy land. Bismillahi-rRahmani-r-Rahim is the crown of Islam on the heads of Muslims. You must try to keep
it. Every closed door is opening through B.r.r., every treasure from earth and through
Heavens is going to be opened through B.r.r. And that is the sign of sincerity or of
obedience. An obedient person’s sign is to say: Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim.
But Shaitan is making and trying to make it away, Muslims not to say B.r.r. If they say B.r.r., people blame
them, and Muslims also blame each other when a person is saying it continuously, for every occasion and
every work asking to say B.r.r.. Muslims blame Muslims and Muslims are going to be heedless. First class
heedless people on earth now are Muslims. Why they are heedless? Christians are on their way, claiming to
be Christians. It is well known that from the beginning they lost their way and their heedlessness began from
their childhood and going on. But Muslims are on the right path, but through their heedlessness accuse Islam
and its principles and try to change Islamic principles through Non-Muslims principles that are all artificial.
The whole world, Non-Muslim world, uses imitated mind productions instead of real principles that have
been sent from heavens to mankind. But they insist and say "We can find or say or bring better principles
than what Muslims use." No! And they make big advertisement on that point and our heedless Muslims and
their leaders, Nr. Ones, heedless ones, have been cheated and say: "Western civilization reached through
their civilization to a high technology and through it they are going up through space, travelling, looking
around." And their balance for civilization or to be highest level of mankind is to reach more technological
authority. Which country reached more authority from technology they say they are Nr. One. For example
they say America’s technology is much more powerful than Russia’s technology; Russia not reaching level of
America’s technology. And European countries among themselves everyone claim to be on top level of

technology, but German people say: ’You can’t reach to where we are now’, French people say: ’No, we make
Mirage hunter, going up straight, coming down straight’, and going to be competition between French and
German. Russia is saying: ’I don’t care, my technology is better’, and they are behind technology 5o years, but
they say: ’We are first class.’ If they shoot one, second one going to be harmed, damaged. If one going,
sending ten more, or one hundred… Italians say: ’We are not taking too much care for technology, let them
fight each other’, and so on… European, western countries fight which one’s technology is higher, and they
think that the balance of civilization is on their technological level. No, that is their heedlessness.
And our Muslim leaders and cheated communities think: ‘They have atom, nuclear power. Ah, we haven’t, we
must reach to nuclear bombs, nuclear power. But our principles don’t give chance for us up today. We must
change our principles to western principles. We must throw them away and take western principles to reach
to their level.’ And I am asking: ’To where they reach through their weapons?’ You think that is civilization,
nuclear weapons, not to make people to live happily and peacefully, enjoyfully communities? But nuclear
weapons asking to destroy cities, farms, men, women, children, animals, forests- everything. That is their
understanding of civilization. And that this is a real position? If to kill and destroy is the measure of
civilization, may Allah curse them! If that is their measure of civilization as much as to make people to die
and to be their cities, villages and farms destroyed, if we say that this is civilization, may Allah curse them
and their technology!
But they make so wrong advertisement that technology and its principles are the Nr. One principles for
humanity. Never going to be for humanity through technology a principle. Technology occupied through
material world, or technology used by material world, and material world you cannot find on it good
characteristics, because technology belongs to the material world and nothing from our five senses. Therefore
can’t be technology or high technology a measure for civilization, but what we shall do? Our heedless leaders
leading Islamic countries think that technology is final means to reach civilization. And they cheat people,
they are liars.
Now the whole world is on the line of technology, making competition, which one is going to be first, and for
that purpose they quarrel and fight, and the final result is going to be against them, because technology
should destroy everything. First their civilization. Western civilization is going to die or to be destroyed,
which means to die, to be killed. But they are not thinking on it, neither Europeans, western countries, nor no

mind people from heedless Muslims, who ask principles of western countries that we are saying Europe or
western civilization represents wildness, violence. Wild animals have wildness, but for mankind we don’t say
wild, we must say violent people. For animals it is normal to be wild, because they are not going to be
educated. No schools, universities, academies for them. They are not educated, but you, o mankind. It is
blame for mankind that is educated through so many schools, high education, and that graduates as a violent
person. A violent one is worse than a wild animal. No blame for animals to be wild, but for man to be violent
there is the biggest blame on them, and they are educated and graduated. Blame on them!
Violence is coming through technology. People are not going to be educated through spiritual values. No
spirituality for mankind now. You think spirituality is for animals? In jungles? You are going to teach them
spirituality? If you are not interested in spirituality it is for them? For mountains, jungles or the inhabitants
there? Spirituality is not for them, it is for us. And 21st century’s people are only interested in technology,
never interested in spiritual values, to learn. And materialism makes their way to violence. Everywhere you
are looking, 99% of the news is about violence among people, among communities, among nations, among
races, among continents and among oceans… And look through their TV- only advertising and asking to
teach youngsters violence, nothing else. To kill, to destroy, to burn- nothing else. That is their civilization.
They must be blamed and be ashamed that they say to be civilized people.
And as long as people don’t take care for their spiritual being, they should be much more violent. Now people
run through streets, thousands of people saying: ’We are not asking war, we are asking peace.’ I am asking:
’Did you bring peace to yourself first of all?’ If you brought peace to yourself and everyone, then that country
is going to be in peace. If you find they didn’t reach to peace, that person makes the whole community
unhappy and no peace for that community.
And people now are lying, and also leaders are lying, because every country is governed by politicians, and
their capital is to cheat people; to say and to use lies to cheat people. That is politicians’ importance, nothing
else. Asking through that to reach to power. According to their minds and knowledge, if a person reaches
power or the power point, he should be happy through his life- and they don’t say: Next life- but that he
should be so happy to reach one point of power.
In the 19th century up to the 2oth century the power point was only one. One person had the power point, but
now countless people come and sit on power points, and they are asking to do everything through that power

that has been given, that is for them honour and peace. As much as people get more and more on power
points, troubles and sufferings increase. As much as making it less and less, then troubles come down to the
point of zero. But the biggest satanic teaching through democracy is to make a possibility for everyone to
reach the power station, power point, and to do as he likes. And they never reach through their power a
pleasure, because every time our authority for reaching to power station is going to be more and more, also
our troubles and suffering increase more and more.
Therefore we are saying now that to say Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim is our honour, the honour of
servanthood. But heedless people, ignorant and dishonoured people, don’t use the holy Names of Allah
Almighty. They ask to be said their names(instead), such in our countries, they are not making for people to
say the Name of Allah Almighty, but for every occasion they say someone’s name and: ‘He said like this, he
ordered like that.’ They try to put a person who disappeared instead of the Lord of Heavens. And they are so
proud not to declare His Name and His principles, but (others) that have no value.
And if you say Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim, they get to fight to you and say: ’For what you say this?
Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim you can only say through mosques, not anywhere else. You cannot use it
through social functions, but you must say: ‘Our leader was saying this’, you cannot say Bismillahi-rRahmani-r-Rahim.’ If you say: ‘That is Allah Almighty’s order’, they say: ’No, you must not be in our time and
our century among ourselves. Your principles are not suitable for our communities and our community
functions.’ For community functions they prevent to be said or to begin with: ‘Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-rRahim, we are working for His honour.’ They are not saying this. They take it away to say: ’We do this work
for the honour of our Lord’, because, they say: ’Our leader once upon a time said like this and like that, and
we are following him.’ I am asking: ’Your leaders that do everything against heavenly principles, from whom
graduated?’ They are surprised and say: ’You don’t know from which university graduated? And who is giving
them these diplomas? What is that?’ I am saying: ’From Shaitan.’ All of them graduated through Shaitan,
therefore they say for community functions: ’Our leader was saying like this.’ I am saying: ‘Your leader is (a
man,) like yourself. If he passed away, go and open his grave and look what is there.’ ‘You can’t say this. You
are ordering us? What is that foolishness?’
Al of them graduated by Shaitan, who is giving to them their PhD to make them to loose the right path and to
come to the wrong way. When you say Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim Allah Almighty sends to you angels to

keep you on His true way towards His direct pleasement. Therefore Shaitan is very angry if a person says
Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim. And there is no way to the land of blessings except for who is saying
Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim. Who says Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim may reach the holy land, the land
of Paradise. Otherwise he doesn’t come in it and he never smells its good smell also. The beautiful good smell
from Paradise is coming from a distance of 5oo years. A Mu’min, a believer, is going to smell that beautiful
smell of Paradise from a distance of 5oo years. Those who object on Paradise are not even going to smell...
Lefke - 18.02.2002
